name: Firewall Map+
author: J. Parisi
description: Live OPNsense Firewall Map+ traffic, blocked sources and threat hosts in the Omarchy bar, with a movable world map and host block controls.

barWidget.description: Live OPNsense world map of flows and blocked sources

schema.label: OPNsense address
schema.description: Base URL of the OPNsense GUI, without a trailing slash.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Poll the current firewall summary every second; collector samples are normally two seconds apart.

schema.label: Minimum block hits to show
schema.description: Passed to Firewall Map+ as blocks_min.

schema.label: Resolve hostnames
schema.description: Use the firewall's reverse DNS cache for host labels; IP addresses remain available.
